title: Two fixes blocked in main.js
question: The safety check blocked edits to game3d/js/main.js (the game's core loop, shared by many agents). Both fixes below need it. Allow them?

options.label: Lock movement during Mori's greeting
options.note: Your request: finish Mori's sequence in one go. Movement is held from his greeting until the lead-in ends; talking to him and the Say menu still work, and he bows if you try to walk. It only holds once you know a word, so you can never be shut in. Without it the phone test walked off and the day went on with Mori left standing.

options.label: Fix a possible softlock in walking
options.note: Found by the Mori agent: when a walk ends at once (already at the target), the code crashes ('watch' used before it exists), so the lift trip to B2 can fail. One-line fix: declare it earlier.
